## Why generics

Compile-time type safety without casts. `List<String>` guarantees only strings go in and come out.

## Type erasure

Generics are erased at runtime — you cannot do `new T[]` or `instanceof List<String>`. This is why reflection sees raw types.

## PECS

**Producer Extends, Consumer Super**: `? extends T` to read, `? super T` to write. Bounded wildcards make APIs flexible.
